tools.name: search_courts
tools.description: Search tennis, padel and pickleball courts in a covered city, metro area or around a point. Use 'city' (e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Long Beach', 'Tbilisi' or 'Los Angeles area'; 'country' if the name is ambiguous) or 'lat'+'lon'+'radius_km'. Results are venues (courts within 70 m are merged) with number of

tools.name: get_court
tools.description: Get full details of one court venue by id (from search_courts): courts per sport, surface, access, OpenStreetMap links, source, data date and caveats.

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: List the covered cities with the number of venues per sport, the data date and the attribution.
